chain.title: Dependency chain
chain.aria: Dependency chain from the affected resource
chain.note: The chain shows what the affected resource depends on. “Candidate” is a hypothesis that explains others, not a confirmed cause.

unknownEntry: Entry not recognised by this version of the interface

monitoring.title: With monitoring enabled, the diagnosis will be more precise and complete
monitoring.generic: Monitoring data could not be used here. Diagnostics are based on Kubernetes data only and stay complete without it.

correlation.note: This is a likely shared source, not a proven cause: check it before acting.
correlation.lowHint: Low confidence: treat this as a hint only.
correlation.truncated: The list is truncated: {shown} of {total} shown.
correlation.potentialNote: These workloads share the source but show no problems yet.
correlation.incompleteForbidden: The list is incomplete: no permission to read some data.
correlation.recomputeHint: Re-reads the cluster; the report, events and logs stay unchanged.
correlation.recomputeClosed: A closed investigation is not recalculated.
correlation.recomputeUnavailable: Recalculation is not available in this version of the backend.
correlation.symptomHint: Low confidence: the same symptom in the namespace, with no structural link found.

problem.title: Problems
problem.subtitle: Investigations that share a likely source are grouped into one problem. Grouping never deletes or merges investigations.
problem.detachedNote: {n} investigations were detached and will not be added again automatically.
problem.safeNote: Investigations are not deleted or merged: only their grouping changes.
problem.needOperate: Changing problems requires the operate permission.
problem.createHint: Select investigations that are not in a problem yet.
problem.createEmpty: All investigations already belong to a problem.

confirm.attach: Attach this investigation to the problem?
confirm.detach: Detach this investigation from the problem?
confirm.merge: Merge this problem into the selected one?
confirm.create: Create a problem from the selected investigations?

outcome.optionalHint: Nothing here is required. Anything you leave unmarked is simply not recorded.
outcome.rejected: Hypotheses you checked and ruled out
outcome.otherAction: Something that was not in the recommendations helped (describe it in the note)
outcome.resolvedAtHint: Leave empty to use the moment you mark the result. Not earlier than the investigation was opened, not in the future.
outcome.correlation: Possible common source: was it right?

errors.tooMany: Too many marks in one list: no more than 20 are accepted.
errors.resolvedBeforeOpen: The resolution time cannot be earlier than the moment the investigation was opened.
errors.resolvedInFuture: The resolution time cannot be in the future.
errors.resolvedInvalid: The resolution time could not be read.
